newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to buy kerosene for April arrival.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy kerosene for April arrival.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy superior kerosene for April delivery, traders said on Thursday.
The tender seeks 40,000-to-45,000-tonne cargoes for delivery to Madras or Haldia on the Indian east coast, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis.
The tender closes on March 6 and offers will be valid until 2200 hours, India time on March 7.
In its last tender, IOC purchased one kerosene cargo for March delivery from Kuwait Petroleum Corp (KPC) at $34 per tonne over Mediterranean spot quotes, c-and-f east coast.
